description.en: Enables or disables added stoppage/loss time at the end of a match half.
True to disable loss time, false to allow it.
Always null — the native implementation never pushes a value onto the stack on success; null is also returned if no disable argument was given.

example.code:
// Disable stoppage time for this scripted match
CMND_BTL_NO_LOSSTIME(true);
